edits.current: Maintain a rolling six-month average of labour income YEAR-ROUND and store it monthly. On a termination, use the average of the last six months OF EMPLOYMENT. The average drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption: full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026), tapered above.
edits.proposed: Maintain the monthly salary history YEAR-ROUND and store it monthly, so that the six-month average can be taken for the event that applies. The average is the monthly average SALARY ('salario mensual promedio', ET art. 206 num. 4) of six months: on termination or on a withdrawal of severance, the last six months of employment or the six months before the withdrawal; while the employment continues, the six months of the immediately preceding year at the time of the deposit to the fund; for employees outside the Ley 50 de 1990 regime, the six months before the employer recognises the severance (ET art. 27 num. 3) (DIAN Concepto 4443 de 2025). The average drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption: full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026), tapered above.
edits.why: #11: aligned with Formulario 220 Spec M51 (monthly average salary, window set by the event; M51 unchanged).
edits.evidence: Formulario 220 Spec M51 (same workbook); raw/docs/oficiais/CO/2026-10-21-DIAN-Concepto-4443-2025.htm

edits.current: Casilla 59. Drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper; must be maintained year-round.

Drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper; the salary history must be maintained year-round.

edits.current: DISPLAY-ONLY - not a data field, not populated by payroll, not transmitted. The six declarations are: (1) gross wealth did not exceed 4,500 UVT; (2) gross income was below 1,400 UVT; (3) not a VAT-responsible person at 31 December; (4) credit-card consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (5) total purchases and consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (6) total bank deposits, receipts or financial investments did not exceed 1,400 UVT. Where all six hold, the note on the form states that THIS CERTIFICATE SUBSTITUTES FOR ALL LEGAL PURPOSES for the income-tax return. THIS IS THE ONLY REASON THE EMPLOYEE-DECLARED SECTIONS EXIST ON THE FORM.
edits.proposed: DISPLAY-ONLY - not a data field, not populated by payroll, not transmitted. The six declarations are: (1) gross wealth did not exceed 4,500 UVT; (2) gross income was below 1,400 UVT; (3) not a VAT-responsible person at 31 December; (4) credit-card consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (5) total purchases and consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (6) total bank deposits, receipts or financial investments did not exceed 1,400 UVT. Where all six hold, the note on the form states that THIS CERTIFICATE SUBSTITUTES FOR ALL LEGAL PURPOSES for the income-tax return (Formulario 220 prescribed by Res. DIAN 000022 de 2024, block 'Certifico que durante el ano gravable' and the note on the form; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.7). THIS IS THE ONLY REASON THE EMPLOYEE-DECLARED SECTIONS EXIST ON THE FORM.
edits.why: #20: citation added.
edits.evidence: Formulario 220: 'Certifico que durante el año gravable: 1. Mi patrimonio bruto no excedió de 4.500 UVT. 2. Mis ingresos brutos fueron inferiores a 1.400 UVT. 3.
